source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.3, printed pages 270-277.

blocks.text: Muscle (patha) woh tissue hai jo ek tarteeb aur hum-aahangi se sukar (contract ho) kar jism ke hisson ya poore jism ko harkat deta hai. Muscle ke alag alag cells ko muscle fibres ya myofibres kehte hain.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Muscles ka sukarna aur dheela hona sirf jism ko harkat hi nahin deta, balke woh zor bhi deta hai jo khoon aur khaane jaisi cheezon ko jism ke andar aage dhakelta hai.
